{{Top|leg}}
The '''North Plateau''' was a region of [[Lucazec/Legends|Lucazec]] where [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Akanah Norand Goss Pell|Akanah]] landed the ''[[Mud Sloth]]''. It had no true [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], but only an airfield identified by latitude and longitude.<ref name="BTS">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref>
